personalInfo.about:
Mobile Software Engineer with 5 years of experience building scalable, high-performance applications across mobile, web, and desktop platforms. Specialized in Android development with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, alongside extensive experience delivering production-grade Flutter applications.

Throughout my career, I have contributed to 15+ applications across various industries, including ERP, POS, e-commerce, booking, delivery, and government solutions, delivering products for diverse markets across the Middle East, including Egypt and GCC countries such as Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, and Oman.

Experienced in designing clean and maintainable architectures using Clean Architecture, MVVM, SOLID principles, and modern development practices. Skilled in integrating REST APIs, Firebase services, payment gateways, maps, notifications, local databases, and implementing testing strategies to build reliable and scalable products.

Passionate about building impactful software experiences, writing clean code, improving performance, and collaborating with teams to create solutions that solve real-world problems and deliver business value.

Currently focused on advancing my expertise in native mobile development across Android and iOS platforms, while continuously strengthening my software engineering capabilities through modern architectures, scalable design principles, and industry best practices.
